unit_basis: The source MRML scene identifies 3D Slicer 4.4.0. Official Slicer coordinate documentation declares native model vertices in millimeters. The source scene retains same-subject MRI with 0.75 mm spacing and model coordinates of comparable head-scale magnitude. Original point coordinates retain metric scale 1.0; no image alignment or anatomical axis conversion is asserted. Documentation: https://www.slicer.org/wiki/Slicer3%3ACoordinates
source_file_choice: Canonical source catalogue DataSource and active MRML ModelStorage files ending sulcus1.vtk. Unsuffixed copies contain identical geometric arrays and are not additional anatomical structures.
independent_vtk_reader_scope: Read-only audit cross-check; VTK is not a construction or application runtime dependency.
source_attributes: Original binary attribute arrays are retained in the new source-geometry NPZ records with original names, association, binary hashes and provenance. Display mesh generation preserves vertices and face indices exactly.

constructed_package.validation: fresh asset SHA256 and geometry passed; independent VTK reader confirms every original point, triangle and source attribute; anatomical review not performed
